ns2:section.sectionText: LEEP; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@uiuc.edu); Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Format: This course has four required all-day meetings. Three of these are in Chicago at the Puerto Rican Cultural Center (2739-41 W. Division) on August 26, October 21 and December 2; the fourth is in Champaign during LEEP on-campus weekend on Sunday, October 1. In addition there will be up to six online sessions using synchronous (real-time) technologies (possible LEEP session dates include: August 31, September 14, October 12, 26, November 9, 30.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
